subject: Mythology
title: The Frost Giants of Jotunheim
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Frost Giants of Jotunheim usable.

hook.text: The frost giants were the gods' oldest enemies, massive beings of ice who lived beyond the edge of the world.

buildup.text: They descended from Ymir, the first giant, and they never forgave the gods for killing their ancestor.

discovery.text: Despite the rivalry, gods and giants intermarried. Odin's mother was a giantess. Thor's mother was too.

twist.text: The giants were not simply evil. They represented chaos and nature's raw power, beyond any god's full control.

climax.text: At Ragnarök, the frost giants finally marched on Asgard, fulfilling a grudge older than the world itself.

punchline.text: The gods built the world from a giant's corpse and never stopped paying for it.

quiz.question: What surprising connection existed between gods and frost giants?
options: They shared the same magical powers
Many gods had giantess mothers, including Thor and Odin
The giants originally helped build Asgard
